facts.body1: Work in the language you know.

featureBodies.0: Organize student records, classes, subjects and teaching teams.
featureBodies.1: Coordinate timetables and record attendance in the same workspace.
featureBodies.2: Manage examinations, grades and publication of results.
featureBodies.3: Track fees, recorded payments, balances and receipts.
featureBodies.4: Keep documents and announcements within reach of your teams.
featureBodies.5: Bring campus operations together while keeping access scoped.

roleBodies.0: Follow campus activity and coordinate the teams responsible for daily operations.
roleBodies.1: Organize classes, attendance, results and documents using dedicated workspaces.
roleBodies.2: Find schedules, published results and the information available to your role.

questions.1: Does everyone see the same information?
questions.3: Are all modules available to everyone?

answers.0: Yes. The platform includes multi-campus oversight and workspaces scoped to individual campuses.
answers.1: No. Access depends on the authenticated role, campus and applicable ownership rules.
answers.2: The ERP currently supports ten interface languages, including Arabic with right-to-left layouts. Use the language selector to explore them.
answers.3: Module availability depends on the offer and configuration of each campus. Product illustrations do not grant access to these modules.
answers.4: Applications, programs and applicant activities belong to the separate public portal. Use the enrollment link in the footer.
